【原视频简介】
GPT-6 Astra vs Claude Fable 5.1 — which model actually wins?

In this video I compare the strongest game, 3D, coding, creative-direction and benchmark examples I could find, including same-prompt tests, early-access builds and independent comparisons.

I tried to keep the comparison fair: not every viral clip is a true 1:1 test, so I label different harnesses, unrelated showcases and Seedance-rendered examples when relevant.
